testcase.name: valid mixed case range unit completes the artifact
unsolicited 304 cannot publish an empty artifact
cut off chunked response removes temporary bytes
cut off gzip response removes temporary bytes
short other encoded response cannot publish partial bytes
correct mixed case gzip decodes the body
chunked range obeys its content range without content length
short chunked range cannot publish a partial artifact
empty close delimited response is a valid empty artifact
correct deflate body decodes without comparing decoded and wire lengths
concurrent callers never publish the same short artifact
concurrent callers share one correct artifact download
HEAD metadata length does not require response bytes
chunked range must consume the closing chunk before publishing
chunked range rejects data beyond its stated range
range data stays temporary until the closing chunk arrives
no body status with a saved prefix is rejected and cleaned
unknown and empty encodings cannot publish response bytes
mixed case deflate is decoded
chunked gzip validates the closing chunk after its trailer
valid chunked gzip is decoded through the closing chunk
complete framing cannot hide an incomplete gzip trailer
invalid gzip header removes a saved temporary prefix
encoded resume cannot append decoded bytes to an earlier representation
gzip decoder completion still checks the declared response length
deflate decoder completion still checks the declared response length
chunked deflate validates the closing chunk after decoding
valid chunked deflate is decoded through the closing chunk
mixed case stacked content codings decode in reverse order
corrupt gzip trailer cannot publish decoded data
corrupt deflate checksum cannot publish decoded data
gzip members in separate chunks all decode before publication
empty encoded body with one byte buffer still validates its trailer
body bearing successful statuses retain their complete artifact bytes
encoded download output error is not reported as a coding error
HTTP error responses retain their complete original download error
